tasks.label: Astro: Start Dev Server
tasks.detail: Starts the local development server at http://localhost:4321 with hot reloading

tasks.label: Astro: Build Site
tasks.detail: Runs 'astro build' to generate static production assets in ./dist

tasks.label: Astro: Preview Build
tasks.detail: Runs 'astro preview' to inspect the built static files locally

tasks.label: Astro: New Post / Folklore Story
tasks.detail: Interactively create a new Folklore story or Dispatch in src/content/posts/

tasks.label: Astro: Add Publication (via DOI)
tasks.detail: Fetch metadata by DOI and insert into src/data/publications.bib

tasks.label: CV: Check Differences with cv.tex
tasks.detail: Compares publications.bib against ~/GitHub/fpcv/cv.tex to find missing entries

tasks.label: CV: Generate Formatted LaTeX for cv.tex
tasks.detail: Formats publications into the exact \yearsheader{} LaTeX macro format for cv.tex

tasks.label: Astro: Check Image Sizes (Dry Run)
tasks.detail: Inspect public/images for oversized photos and calculate potential space savings

tasks.label: Astro: Optimize Images (In-Place)
tasks.detail: Safely compress & resize oversized images in public/images to 2048px retina masters

tasks.label: Astro: Audit Unused Images (Dry Run)
tasks.detail: Scans public/images for unreferenced images and reports breakdown

tasks.label: Astro: Move Unused Images to _unused_images_review/
tasks.detail: Safely moves unreferenced images to _unused_images_review/ and generates MANIFEST.md

tasks.label: Astro: Restore Moved Images back to public/images/
tasks.detail: Restores any moved images from _unused_images_review/ back to public/images/

tasks.label: Astro: Build Search Index (Pagefind)
tasks.detail: Re-index site content for instant local search in dev mode
